summary: Actual complete collections, binary/tensor checkpoint identity, 72 prediction metrics and all derived arithmetic independently verified. No adverse seed results omitted; cost summaries retain GPU and training-seed strata.
methods: Original recovery.verify and verified_collection validated source bindings, archive/manifest/transport/extracted bytes; no comparator CLI or aggregate called.
Manual phase/cardinality/terminal-probe/GPU allowlist checks used recorded local evidence, not a new live probe.
Each selected checkpoint tensor digest independently reconstructed from sorted name/dtype/shape/raw CPU bytes; no model built or inference executed.
All 72 compressed prediction files independently aggregated with NumPy, strict truth > cutoff and original split/order checks.
NumPy ddof=1 summaries, direct subtraction/division, sorted medians, raw 4096-target throughput, MiB=bytes/1048576 and CSV cell equality independently recomputed without invoking build_summary.py.
limitations: Timing comparisons apply within the recorded GPU and training seed; 5080/5090 and cuDNN 91900/92000 differ.
Parent-recorded dispatcher OS exit0 and scientific child exits were verified. The supervisor/parent own OS exit was not directly observed and is not claimed.
Cost eval uses fixed Train batches, not Test inference throughput. Train profiling uses fresh optimizer copies and does not resume scientific fit.
Only local archived evidence was reviewed; no fresh live process or GPU observation was made.
Recorded TimeNLL retains the original artifact definition; tiny tail values and large Test changes do not establish general time-model superiority.
